reviews.title: AS2 core language, legacy events/operators, XML/LoadVars, BitmapData/filters and text conformance
reviews.summary: Closes AS1/AS2 legacy on/onClipEvent handlers, Flash 4 operators and property constants, Sound(target), Number radix formatting, Object primitive boxing, instanceof, XML.send POST, and BitmapData.loadBitmap linkage; verifies core language, XML/LoadVars, Selection/timers, Color, BitmapData, nine filters, TextFormat, StyleSheet, TextSnapshot, and TextField.
